name: Takino (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Takino town emblem in green: a ring open at the top with a pointed base, enclosing a disc.
history: Flag of the former town of Takino in Hyōgo Prefecture, dissolved on 2006-03-20. The municipal emblem was adopted in October 1956.

features.role: Takino town emblem — a ring open at the top with a pointed base, enclosing a disc
